Hi Emma — thanks for the availability and the context. Short answer: yes, we can do a staggered session that minimizes late-night presence for your SGT team while preserving a live handoff between our SDR and AE. Two possible patterns I recommend: 

1) Split / overlap (60/30): US SDR runs a 60-minute open demo (intro + product fit) in ET; AE joins 30 minutes before the end to take over for the technical deep-dive. The Singapore engineer joins the final 30 minutes for targeted Q&A.

2) Record + live Q&A: 30–40 minute recorded demo delivered ahead of time, then a 30-minute live Q&A scheduled for an SGT-friendly time window.

A couple of scheduling constraints to flag: EU DST ends later in October this year, but US DST shift on Nov 7 will affect late-year handoffs — for June there are no DST conflicts yet, but our EU AE (Logan) is in a +1 timezone and can cover the 14:00 ET window comfortably.

Proposed concrete slots (I converted to ET/CEST/SGT):
- Option A: Thu Jun 10, 07:30–08:30 ET / 13:30–14:30 CEST / 20:30–21:30 SGT (Staggered: AE joins at 08:00 ET)
- Option B: Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:00 ET / 20:00–21:00 CEST / 03:00–04:00 SGT (Less ideal for SGT)
- Option C: Tue Jun 8, 11:30–12:15 ET (record demo sent 24h prior) + Thu Jun 10, 21:00–21:30 SGT for live Q&A (short Q&A for APAC)

I'll let Logan weigh in on the handoff timing. If you like Option A, I can send calendar invites and a version of the deck tailored to start with clinical workflow examples. I attached the v3 deck and a draft mutual action plan for redlines.

Thanks — Mina
